scope: Paired development continuation, not scratch convergence or formal acceptance
trigger: On exact recorded trajectories, h32/lambda.95 mean absolute state target bias was.910/.935 before/after collapse; h512/lambda.95 remained.890/.911, whereas h512/lambda1 reduced it to.048/.002. The short historical-policy KL intervention failed final retention.
hypothesis: Finite-rollout GAE targets with lambda.95 transmit too much critic error to policy updates. Increasing the return horizon and using lambda1 may improve capability retention despite greater target variance.

shared_changes_from_source.reason: Both arms use51.2-second rollouts and64 worlds.64 minibatches keep512 frames per actor/critic optimizer step, equal to the original32x64/4. The sequence composition and recurrent gradient horizon still change and are disclosed.

unchanged: Actor/critic/Adam states, learning rates, reward, gamma1, physical/controller/sensor conditions, RNG, curriculum denominator, epochs and KL limit. No rehearsal or fitting to calibration episodes. Both use deterministic compilation only for the training update and original evaluation numerics.
checks: Source full-state identity preserved under new learner options
Source action likelihood and recurrent recomputation
Actual long GPU update finite and repeatable across production/diagnostic paths
Exact original48-case frozen replay before learning
Full final learner state and complete per-case checks
decision: At the actual final update require >=80% retention of the21 source successes for candidate promotion; compare all checks and new/lost cases between arms. If lambda1 loses old cases despite more accurate targets, reject it as a sufficient remedy. If both arms retain capabilities, do not attribute the improvement uniquely to lambda. Any candidate still needs full scratch training,3seeds, original scene thresholds and the formal>=900000-interaction stability window.
comparison_limit: The two new arms have exactly equal budgets and differ only in lambda. Compared with the earlier h32 branch, rollout/gradient horizon, optimizer sequence composition, curriculum update granularity and total interactions differ; do not treat that cross-family comparison as a single-factor causal test.
